resources.string: Activation link scanned. Choose how to approve sign-ins, then tap Enroll.
That QR code is not a Frict activation link. It was not opened.
Without the camera, paste the activation link below or open it as a link on this phone.
Could not start the camera: %1$s. Paste the activation link instead.
The name is shown on this phone only. Leave it empty to keep the suggested one.
Could not save the name; the account is shown as %1$s.
This phone already has that account.
That is not a Frict activation link.
Your fingerprint, or the PIN, pattern or password that unlocks this phone.
Only a fingerprint. Adding a fingerprint to this phone, or removing them all, invalidates the key: then remove the account and enroll again.
Approve sign-ins with: %1$s. To change, remove the account, then enroll again.
Set a screen lock (PIN, pattern or password) first: this phone can\'t enroll without one.
Fingerprint only needs a fingerprint set up first. Set one up, or choose Fingerprint or screen lock.
The server refused the enrollment (HTTP %1$d). The link may be used or expired.
Enrolled, but the enrollment could not be saved on this device.
Could not check for sign-in requests: %1$s
Report this sign-in as not you
Denied and reported as not you.
The sign-in request is no longer pending.
The server says this sign-in request was already answered or has expired.
The server does not know this sign-in request.
Removes this phone from the account on its server, then deletes the account\'s keys here. This phone can\'t approve its sign-ins until enrolled again. Other accounts stay.
Removed on the server, but could not remove the account from this phone. Try again.
The server could not be told
Could not remove this phone on the server: %1$s. Remove anyway deletes the account and its keys from this phone only; the server keeps its enrollment.
Could not remove the account from this phone.

Android invalidated its approval key. With Fingerprint only, that happens when a fingerprint is added, all fingerprints are removed, or the screen lock is removed. Remove the account, then enroll again.
Android invalidated its approval key. With Fingerprint or screen lock, that happens when the screen lock is removed. Remove the account, then enroll again.
Its device key is gone from this phone, so it can\'t check for sign-in requests or sign anything. Remove the account, then enroll again.
This version of Frict is too old for the server. Update it to approve sign-ins.
No app on this phone can open web pages. The privacy policy is at %1$s.
No app on this phone can open Google Play. Update Frict from Google Play.
